mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 5.0%, the Federal Reserve accelerates tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), labor market tightness drives wage growth and corporate profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates strengthening supply chain conditions and corporate capacity utilization, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has risen for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP growth rate exceeds 2.5% (annualized), it signals strong economic expansion, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to premature rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI inflation and a lagged increase in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and rising FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes, a surge in housing starts above 1200 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and rising home purchases, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1200.0 units in an early-cycle expansion regime.
